questions.prompt: Which shows a frame on the wire, in order?
On the way down the stack, each layer adds its header in front of what the layer above gave it.
What's the name of the process where each layer removes its own header on the way up the stack?
What three-letter abbreviation names the checksum in a frame's trailer?
A frame arrives and its FCS doesn't match the receiver's own checksum. What happens?
options: The receiver fixes the flipped bit
The frame is passed up anyway
The receiver asks the router for a copy

questions.prompt: Why does an Ethernet frame put the destination MAC address first?
options: So a switch can start deciding where to send the frame before the rest arrives

questions.prompt: Is network byte order big-endian or little-endian?
How many bytes does struct.pack("!HH", 80, 443) produce? (a number)
In the exercise's frame format, how many bytes does the link layer add around a packet, counting header and trailer? (a number)
The receiver's network layer reads the packet header. What does it do with the segment header and data after it?
options: Treats them as one opaque payload and hands it up to the transport layer
